text: The Pestana Group was founded by Manuel Pestana, who with his son Dionísio Pestana, its owner and Chairman, expanded the group internationally; the group says it bought Madeira's brewery, the island's market leader in beer and soft drinks, in the 1990s.
short: Pestana Group: owned and chaired by Dionísio Pestana; his group says it bought the Madeira brewery (ECM) in the 1990s.

source.name: Pestana Group: Founders
source.quote: together with his son, Dionísio Pestana, owner and Chairman, expanded the brand's footprint internationally
source.note: The same page, in the 1990s section of the timeline, says: 'In Madeira the group buys the Madeira Beer Company, the island's market leader producing beer and soft drinks.'
